# Database and Migration Rules

These rules apply to SQLAlchemy models, repositories, Alembic migrations, and deployment changes that affect the database.

- Keep database access behind the existing async repository and session patterns.
- Every model or schema change requires a reviewed Alembic migration.
- Review autogenerated migrations manually before applying them.
- Enum values use string-backed check constraints in this project. When enum values change, explicitly replace the constraint and handle any required data fix.
- Preserve backward compatibility during rolling deployments. New application code must tolerate the old schema until the migration is complete, and old code must not fail while the new schema is being introduced.
- Make transaction boundaries explicit and keep partial job progress resumable.
- Document deployment ordering, rollback limits, and data migration implications when they affect operations.

Use the Docker-based migration commands in [`docs/DEVELOPMENT.md`](../../docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) for local verification.
